about_short_description.short_description: Instant B2B payments platform for global companies

product.name: Real-Time Card-to-Card Transfers
product.description: A platform enabling instant money transfers between debit cards, supporting fund disbursement and automated collections 24/7 without ACH restrictions.

product.name: B2B2C Payouts API
product.description: An API to program, automate, and execute fund disbursements to suppliers, partners, and customers with multi-level authorization and fraud monitoring.

product.name: B2B Payins Instant Collection
product.description: A solution enabling instant payment collection from any bank with one-click payments, supporting single and recurring debits directly on client platforms.

identifier.value: P2P Cash In and Cash Out with Tokenization

product.name: P2P Cash In and Cash Out with Tokenization
product.description: A customizable solution for personal cash transfers and wallet reloads with tokenization of multiple cards, enabling real-time transfers and payments for services and subscriptions.

product.name: International Border Payments
product.description: A service enabling fast, simple, and instant international remittance transfers integrated into client channels for global money sending and receiving.

identifier.value: Buy Now, Pay Later Credit Service

product.name: Buy Now, Pay Later Credit Service
product.description: A digital credit service allowing businesses to purchase supplies immediately and pay later in interest-free installments through a simple online process.
